text:
Fixed the panel title and subtitle styling bug.

Root cause: title and subtitle text only received `partial_border_style`, excluding the panel-level background style.

Change: apply the combined `border_style` to both title and subtitle, preserving their own foreground styles while inheriting the panel background. All `tests/test_panel.py` tests pass.

final_text:
Fixed the panel title and subtitle styling bug.

Root cause: title and subtitle text only received `partial_border_style`, excluding the panel-level background style.

Change: apply the combined `border_style` to both title and subtitle, preserving their own foreground styles while inheriting the panel background. All `tests/test_panel.py` tests pass.
